parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Odufor (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 20.32 | 0.13606 | 0.13606
2 | 851.16 | 1.1039 | 1.2399
3 | 2511.9 | 15.803 | 17.043
4 | 1345 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Odufor
Curve type: AK-type ($\rho_1 < \rho_2 < \rho_3 > \rho_4$)
Aquifer depth: > 17.04 m
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of at least 40 to 50 m to fully penetrate the saturated sand aquifer underlying the resistive third layer. Ensure proper geophysical logging and casing installation with well screens positioned within the productive zone below 17.04 m.
